captures.title: Employee profile photo
captures.steps: Open the employee → Personal.
captures.change: Choose, preview, save, replace or remove an Employee photo.

captures.title: User account photo
captures.steps: Profile photo on Add User; also available on Edit / Manage.
captures.change: The photo chooser now works and shows a preview. Save the user to keep the selected photo.

captures.title: Annual leave balance and year
captures.steps: Open the employee → View → leave balance/year.
captures.change: The selected year and Annual Leave balance are explicit. Only approved Annual Leave in that year reduces the annual balance.

captures.title: Employee bank details
captures.steps: Open the employee → Salary & payment → IBAN.
captures.change: Copied spaces and Arabic/Persian digits are normalized; format/check-digit errors are explained.
captures.status: Needs private confirmation of the exact disputed bank value. This screenshot shows the form, not bank ownership verification.

captures.title: Individual access for one user
captures.steps: Choose the user → Edit / Manage → Individual permissions.
captures.change: Super Admin can set Inherit / Allow / Deny for one person with a reason. A personal Deny takes priority over role grants.

captures.title: Request your own leave
captures.steps: Topbar → My Leave. A unique eligible Employee link is required.
captures.change: The linked employee sees their own requests and balance. New requests remain Pending for HR approval.

captures.title: Automatic Supplier code
captures.steps: Add Supplier → Code. Leave the manual-code checkbox unchecked.
captures.change: The next expected code is visible. The server allocates the final code on save; Save & New refreshes the preview.

captures.title: Automatic Customer code
captures.steps: Add Customer → Code.
captures.change: The same preview/manual-code choice is available for Customers. Existing saved codes are preserved.

captures.title: Supplier papers on the entry screen
captures.steps: Add Supplier or Edit / Manage → Documents.
captures.change: Choose document type, reference, dates and file together with the supplier. Save the parent form to store it.

captures.title: Customer papers on the entry screen
captures.steps: Add Customer or Edit / Manage → Documents.
captures.change: Customer documents stay with their Customer. Saved files have View/Download; Customer View stays read-only.

captures.title: Equipment documents during initial entry
captures.steps: Add Equipment → Documents.
captures.change: Files can be selected before the first save, without moving to a separate View screen.

captures.title: Equipment initial meter
captures.steps: Add Equipment → Initial meter reading.
captures.change: The server saves a blank initial meter as zero; entered readings are kept and negative readings are refused. This image identifies the affected field; the save behavior is covered by regression tests.

captures.title: Old-user review and readable Deactivate action
captures.steps: Users → review exact account IDs and Employee links with the owner.
captures.change: The raw ui.deactivate text is replaced by a readable action. The owner inventory distinguishes displayed codes from actual Employee links.
captures.status: Actual cleanup and any identity correction are still pending the approved list. The fictional accounts pictured were not deleted or deactivated.

captures.title: Master records to review before cleanup
captures.steps: Review Cost Centers, Projects and Sites with the owner.
captures.change: The private inventory identifies retained masters and missing linked references. Newly entered real records are protected from automatic cleanup.
captures.status: Pending item-by-item Keep / Review decisions. This screenshot is a training list, not proof of completed cleanup.

captures.title: Customer overdue reminder
captures.steps: Notifications → Open invoice.
captures.change: After schedule activation, eligible Finance/Super Admin users receive one in-app reminder per overdue invoice/day from one day overdue. Settled or inaccessible invoices are excluded.

captures.title: Supplier recoverable payment and settlement
captures.steps: Choose supplier → Edit / Manage → Supplier advances.
captures.change: Record an agreed recoverable payment, explicitly apply it to an eligible bill, record money returned, or reverse a correction. Finance must configure its dedicated advance asset first.
